facts.production_topology: SINGLE_HOST_DURABLE (one hevi-api process group, --workers 1, in-process worker, host-bound stores; Postgres is the shared DB)
product_surface_gaps: creative memory has no Studio surface (backend/API only)
identity/continuity/repair are wired at required seams but not yet surfaced in the primary produce/Studio flows
facts.horizontal_scaling_requirement: NOT established for the current product stage

rationale: Topology is single-host and no near-term horizontal-scaling requirement is established, so per-host SQLite is adequate. The highest-value next step is to make the now-verified differentiators user-visible and consumed end-to-end in the main production/Studio flows (PRODUCTIZATION), not to distribute durability prematurely. Reopening GPU work is gated on hardware recovery.

triggers_to_switch.DISTRIBUTED_DURABILITY: when a second API/worker host must share the same project/identity/incident authority (then migrate the new authorities onto the existing canonical PostgreSQL infrastructure; do not create a second DB system)
triggers_to_switch.GPU_RUNTIME_RECOVERY: when the lip-sync/local qualification probe reports GPU_AVAILABLE/COMFYUI_REACHABLE/ECHOMIMIC/MODEL/REAL_PROBE/ARTIFACT_VALID all true
